args.title: Fix: re-raise exceptions in get_or_compute instead of swallowing them
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was silently catching all exceptions from the `compute` function and returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This caused dashboards to show stale data after upstream failures with no trace of the error anywhere.

## Root Cause
In `src/cache.py`, the `except Exception` block returned `_last` instead of propagating the exception:
```python
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently
```

## Fix
Changed the `except` block to re-raise the exception, ensuring failures are visible to callers:
```python
except Exception:
    raise
```

This makes failures diagnosable — callers will now see the actual exception rather than silently receiving stale data.

## Tests
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_compute_failure_contract` — now passes (previously failed with `DID NOT RAISE ValueError`)
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_returns_computed_value` — continues to pass
